text:
Iris Nguyen: Hey team, accepted the org invite but I still can't see the private monorepo `redwood-inference/infra-monorepo`. The web UI 404s and gh shows 'Not Found'. Am I missing a step?

Nina (DevEx): Welcome Iris! Do you see any Teams listed on your org profile? Sometimes team membership is provisioned via Okta/SCIM and can lag.

Iris Nguyen: I only see 'Members' and no teams. My Okta shows I'm in the "Platform Engineers" group though.

Raj (IT): @Iris that sounds like SCIM provisioning didn't map your Okta group to the GitHub team. We recently rotated the SCIM token for a short window yesterday; some users needed a resync.

Iris Nguyen: How can we resync? I need access to the infra-monorepo for the onboarding ATP.

Nina (DevEx): Two quick diagnostics: 1) Try `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference --jq .role` to confirm org role. 2) `gh api /orgs/redwood-inference/teams/platform-engineers/memberships/iris` (replace iris with your username) to see team membership.

Iris Nguyen: Ran the first one, it returned "member". Second returned 404.

Raj (IT): Ok that confirms the SCIM mapping didn't add you to the team. I can either trigger a SCIM sync or add you to the team manually. Which do you prefer?

Iris Nguyen: Manual add is fine if it's faster.

Raj (IT): Doing manual add now...

CI Bot: Repo webhook test: infra-monorepo check run queued.

Raj (IT): Added Iris to team `platform-engineers` and granted repo access. Can you try again?

Iris Nguyen: Repo visible now! I can clone: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra-monorepo.git`

Iris Nguyen: Quick follow-up: PRs are blocked by branch protection preventing force-pushes — expected? I tried to push a WIP branch and got `remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update rejected`

Sam (Eng): Yep that's expected. For onboarding, push to a feature branch off main and open a PR. If you need temporary exception for a specific branch (rare), ping the repo maintainers.

Nina (DevEx): We'll also kick off a SCIM resync so future hires won't need manual adds. Raj, can you schedule a resync and check the group mapping?

Raj (IT): SCIM resync initiated. I'll follow up in infra-iam if anything else surfaces.

Onboarding Bot: Onboarding checklist updated: GitHub repo access confirmed (manual team add).

Iris Nguyen: Thanks everyone! Appreciate the quick help.

Nina (DevEx): Welcome aboard Iris :tada: If you want the repo map and starter issues, DM me and I'll drop the onboarding PR checklist.
